safety_evidence: The trace contains batch dispatch and rank-level Store API timing, not destination page generations, zeroing fences, pinned sources, registered staging space or leaf port routes.
network_evidence: The candidate windows exclude observed P0 GETs after the predecessor's last GET. Predecessor device compute and link idleness are unobserved. MAC polls are positioned by a wall-clock offset and cannot certify instantaneous per-port credit.
intervention: Sensitivity only. Each cap retains its own planned offers, request dependencies, EOS, routes, dispatch timestamps, batch contents and descriptor work. The first GET on each rank receives a time credit clipped to its observed duration while all earlier work keeps its original cost. No transfer is rescheduled and there is no calibrated observation of interference or staging cost.
